# Slide-type inventory

Deckyard ships **38** built-in slide types (34 active, 4 deprecated but still rendered for existing decks). A fork may add more under `custom/slide-types/`; those are not counted here.

This table is generated from the registry so the count and the list cannot
drift from the code. To change it, add or remove a type in
`shared/slide-types/registry.js` and regenerate — do not edit this file.

| `title-slide` | Title slide | Active |
| `chapter-title-slide` | Section title | Active |
| `content-slide` | Text slide | Active |
